commands.notes: Root cause captured from PR #329's run: step 5 'Run DB-backed benchmarks (single iteration)' = success, step 6 'Append benchmark results to job summary' = failure (cat: bench.txt: No such file or directory). Same shape on both main runs after #327 (0b17c5d9, 8c8ff37f), where every other CI job was green.

After the fix the bench-perf-smoke steps report working-directory ['-','-','backend','backend'] (benchmark writer and summary reporter agree), the job list is unchanged, and the unit-tests npm list ends with 'npm run test:ci-bench-perf-smoke-workflow'.
2/2 pass with the fix: artifact steps agree on working-directory, and the job stays advisory (label, -benchtime 1x, not listed in ci-summary).

commands.command: node --test tests/scripts/ci-bench-perf-smoke-workflow.test.mjs  # negative control: summary-step working-directory removed
commands.notes: Negative control: with the summary step's working-directory deleted the guard fails as designed (AssertionError: every step touching bench.txt must pin working-directory; got ["backend",""]), proving it would have caught the original defect. Workflow restored afterwards.
docs/harness/failure-registry.md PASS (1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings) after adding FR-010 and refreshing the review date.

knownGaps: No local end-to-end replay of the benchmark -> bench.txt -> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY chain: local npm is intercepted by a WSL shim and no MySQL listens on 127.0.0.1:3306. The authoritative run is this PR's Bench Perf Smoke (advisory) job.
The underlying visibility gap is not closed: by design no gate watches a report-only job, so a future silent red is still only caught by a human reading main's run list (recorded as FR-010).
Promoting bench-perf-smoke to a blocking gate remains a maintainer decision and is explicitly out of scope.

environment.shellCaveat: Local npm/npx are intercepted by a WSL shim (`wsl: ... execvpe(/bin/bash) failed: No such file or directory`), so npm scripts could not be executed locally; the identical command was run directly via `node --test <file>`. CI (ubuntu-latest) uses the normal npm path.
environment.database: No MySQL listening on 127.0.0.1:3306 locally, so the real benchmark -> bench.txt -> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY chain was not replayed locally; its end-to-end evidence comes from the PR run of Bench Perf Smoke (advisory).
